tasks.label: Client: Lint
tasks.command: podman compose -f compose-dev.yml exec client npm run lint

tasks.label: Client: Format
tasks.command: podman compose -f compose-dev.yml exec client npm run format

tasks.label: Server: Black
tasks.command: podman compose -f compose-dev.yml exec server black src/

tasks.label: Server: Ruff Check
tasks.command: podman compose -f compose-dev.yml exec server ruff check src/

tasks.label: Server: Ruff Fix
tasks.command: podman compose -f compose-dev.yml exec server ruff check src/ --fix
